title: Exterior brick academic building with arched central entrance and bicycles
objects_and_counts: At least 4 people are visible in the scene: one adult walking toward the camera in the central foreground, and at least three people located on or near the steps and entrance area (some partly obscured).
A line of parked bicycles is visible along the base of the building in front of the windows; at least 10 distinct bicycle frames/wheels can be counted in the visible portion of the row.
Four white freestanding barrier structures (short rectangular fences) are visible on the paved area in front of the building; they are placed in two groups across the foreground.
The building facade shows multiple vertical window bays arranged in rows over three main storeys; individual window panes are visible but not uniquely counted beyond being many repeated units.
One arched stone entrance with steps leading up to it is present centrally on the front facade.
Several large trees and trimmed low hedges are visible in the left foreground and along the approach to the building.

Window bays form regular vertical divisions across the three main storeys of the brick building, with the entrance interrupting the row at the center.
Four white barrier structures are placed on the paved forecourt: two nearer the camera and two closer to the building, forming a loose line across the approach.
A large tree stands to the left (image left) of the building and its canopy casts shadows over the left portion of the facade; trimmed hedges and a grass mound occupy the left foreground slope.
A tall modern multi-storey structure rises directly behind the older brick building, visually stacked above it; another modern building is visible on the right (image right) behind the brick facade.
colours_and_materials: The foreground building facade is red-brown brick with vertical stone or concrete trim around the central arched entrance, which appears grey.
The arched entrance and the small projecting architectural details around it appear to be carved or cast stone in a light grey colour.
White plastic or painted wooden barriers are visible on the paved area in front of the building.
Vegetation in the scene is green (trees and grass); the paved forecourt is a medium grey colour.
The taller buildings behind the brick facade are clad in grey and white materials, appearing as smooth panelled or concrete surfaces.
